steps.name: Precondition — create a dedicated disposable agent ('base' version)
Precondition — navigate; confirm 'base' is the active version and (per Test Data purpose) already the pinned/default one
Precondition — edit Instructions, click "Save As Version" to create Draft version 'v1-early-draft'
Precondition — Publish the active version ('v1-early-draft') as 'v2-published', creating a Published version
Precondition — explicitly re-select 'v1-early-draft' (Known defect #614: Publish's own post-publish auto-navigation is unreliable — re-selecting by name is the reliable path)
Precondition — "Save As Version" again from 'v1-early-draft' to create the newest Draft version 'v3-latest-draft' (no further Instructions edit needed — only creation order matters here)
Precondition — confirm 'base' is STILL the pinned/default version at this point (sorts first, with a pin icon) — the state the re-pin below is about to change
Precondition — re-pin 'v1-early-draft' as the agent's default version via the actions menu's 'Set as a default'
Step 1 — Navigate to the agent with base + Draft + Published versions (built above)
Step 2 — Click the version dropdown in the toolbar
